overview: At home you wrote the messenger's entrance and left the half-line blank after The king your father. You paced the six steps of the chamber. Mistress Ansell, below, would have heard a murmur and not the line. The line is still empty. You did not write a song, and you did not write the last line.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the entrance and left the blank.

parties.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
parties.context: Below. Heard a murmur, if she heard anything. Not spoken to.
